instruction: Please help me modify VS Code setting to hide all ".pytest_cache" folders in the explorer view.

metadata.explanation: Task requires hiding .pytest_cache folders in VS Code explorer view. Very similar pattern to original task but targets pytest cache directories. Uses existing check_json_settings metric to verify the files.exclude setting.

llm_judge_reasons: Critical semantic issue with nested dictionary comparison in check_json_settings metric
The metric uses exact equality check (!=) for the entire 'files.exclude' object, not checking if the specific pattern exists within it
If user has pre-existing file exclusion patterns (e.g., '**/.git': true), the evaluator will fail even if '**/.pytest_cache': true is correctly added
Example: {'**/.git': true, '**/.pytest_cache': true} != {'**/.pytest_cache': true} causes incorrect failure
The instruction asks to 'hide .pytest_cache folders' which means adding the pattern, not replacing all existing exclusions
Evaluator cannot correctly verify partial/additive modifications to nested JSON objects
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Modify expected value structure to check for subset/containment rather than exact equality
Use a custom metric that verifies the specific key '**/.pytest_cache': true exists within files.exclude, regardless of other patterns
Alternative: Use a rule-based metric that performs deep nested key checking (e.g., verify data['files.exclude']['**/.pytest_cache'] == true)
Consider using a metric similar to pattern matching rather than exact dictionary equality for nested settings verification

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_json_settings first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
metric check_json_settings second parameter type (str) may not match expected.rules type (Dict)
